L10·N5456unmasked layer
Weak, noisy neuron that peaks on the verb (or its object/word-piece) completing an infinitive/modal construction — e.g. "choose to **buy**", "willing **to** comprise", "will each **assume**", "don't add **water**" — while being strongly suppressed by linking prepositions such as "of"/"with" inside noun phrases.
